document: FICTIONAL TEST DOCUMENT. Cobalt Fern's invented label printer has a twelve-month warranty starting on delivery. Manufacturing defects are covered, including parts and labor; Cobalt Fern may choose repair or replacement. Damage caused by dropping the printer, liquid exposure or a third-party repair is excluded. However, liquid damage from a leak in the original factory-installed ink cartridge is covered if its original tamper seal is intact when the failure occurs; refilled cartridges do not qualify for that exception. Having a third-party repair does not cancel the whole warranty: only damage caused by that repair is excluded, and unrelated manufacturing defects remain covered. The customer initially pays return shipping. If a manufacturing defect is confirmed, Cobalt Fern reimburses documented return shipping up to $20; otherwise shipping is not reimbursed. A $35 inspection fee applies only when no manufacturing defect is found AND the customer consented to that fee in writing before inspection. No other charges or service availability promises appear here. All organizations and facts are fictional; this is not a real warranty.
situation: I own the fictional printer. A third party previously repaired a roller. Now the original factory-installed ink cartridge has leaked while its original tamper seal is intact. I want to understand coverage, return shipping and any inspection fee.
